capabilities: Automatically convert .hwp and .hwpx files to PDF when they are added to the vault
Produce image-based or text-based PDFs with different quality and size trade-offs
Extract document text and tables into a Markdown note
Run conversions manually via the command palette
Optionally delete the original file after conversion
extras: Desktop only; text-based PDFs use a single bundled font (NanumGothic) and omit colour and photos; output quality depends on the @rhwp/core renderer, so complex tables, equations, or unusual fonts may not reproduce perfectly.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or convert Korean HWP/HWPX documents, and existing conversion routes require uploading files to an external server.

relations.evidence: Conversion runs through a Rust + WebAssembly renderer (@rhwp/core)

summary: File converter that automatically turns Korean HWP/HWPX documents into PDFs and optional Markdown notes, fully offline via WebAssembly.
